Self.Wiki: Ride jump-off (formerly Mount Jump Fall; handled by the game's CSRideJumpRegionManImpl). The descent area of a spiritspring. Riding Torrent into it gives the rider and Torrent the jump-off SpEffects from GameSystemCommonParam (rideJumpoff_SpEffectIdPc 185 and rideJumpoff_SpEffectId 184 in retail). An SFX can mark it.

SfxID.Wiki: SFX shown at the region. A negative value uses GameSystemCommonParam rideJumpoff_SfxId, which is -1 (no SFX) in retail. Every retail region uses -1.

SfxHeightOffset.Wiki: Height of the SFX above the region's position. 0 or less uses GameSystemCommonParam rideJumpoff_SfxHeightOffset (0 in retail).
